fireside.speaker: A man, maybe 60s, with tattooed arms
fireside.text: "Stone. We need 58 more for the palisade footings. Creek beds, hillsides — pry it loose."

fireside.speaker: Ziblim
fireside.text: "Stone. We need 53 more for the palisade footings. Creek beds, hillsides — pry it loose."

fireside.speaker: Naran
fireside.text: "Stone. We need 43 more for the palisade footings. Creek beds, hillsides — pry it loose."

fireside.speaker: Sofia
fireside.text: "Stone. We need 16 more for the palisade footings. Creek beds, hillsides — pry it loose."

fireside.speaker: Ziblim
fireside.text: "458 wood. We need 500. The forest isn't going to cut itself."

fireside.speaker: Susan
fireside.text: "Nobody's sleeping. The sky is waiting and nobody knows what to do with their hands."

fireside.speaker: Ivy
fireside.text: "It waits. We wait. Somebody should check the snares — the table doesn't fill the pantry."

fireside.speaker: Sofia
fireside.text: "It eats while we deliberate. The Herald feeds on our stores and we're supposed to just... wait?"

fireside.speaker: Naran
fireside.text: "Did you see their faces? Too many angles. I keep wondering what they want from us."

fireside.speaker: Naran
fireside.text: "Why them? ...Sorry. It's just sitting there, and they're the one who has to sit in it."

tableLines.line: 💔 A faction of Stonebridge has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Nadia.
📓 Codex: Stonebridge split (cannibal). The Red Table formed; 2 petition at Haven's fire.
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Susan speaks at Stonebridge's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
🧳 A traveler passed through yesterday, talking about a village to the northeast called The Red Table. The region is bigger than your fire.
💔 A faction of Emberhold has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table II is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Lena.
A runner from The Red Table, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the northeast ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)
🧳 A traveler says Stonebridge burned — the whole fire, gone. (Wrong. It split: the eaters walked. The Red Table is the new fire.)
🧳 Emberhold has split — the eaters walked. They call the new fire The Red Table II. Half of them were headed this way, or so the traveler says.
🥣 Sam of The Red Table walks into your firelight alone, thinner than you remember. "Our jars are empty," they say. No preamble. "I'm asking for food."
Word later: they walked to The Red Table II. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
Sam waits two days at your fire, getting thinner. Nobody answers. They walk back to The Red Table with nothing. They'll remember the silence.
◈ WORD TRAVELS — riders from The Red Table II bring talk of Haven. Out there they call you the Beloved. Strangers ask for your blessing. You don't know what to do with that.

💔 A faction of Thornfield has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table III is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Sanne.
You see smoke on the horizon. The Red Table III — 2 people, 39 days in. fishing folk, by the look of it. They know 6 plants — 6 new to you. They've been here the whole time.

Fresh-cut stems on the north ground — someone else is working turf your crews use. (The Red Table III's foragers, most likely. You walk the ground yourself: it's thinner than your crews alone could strip it.)

The north ground is thinning faster than your crews alone could strip it. The Red Table III isn't slowing down — their foragers are on your turf most days now. Their speaker would probably want words. (Talk about the shared ground at their fire.)
🧳 Thornfield has split — the eaters walked. They call the new fire The Red Table III. Half of them were headed this way, or so the traveler says.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table III. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
The Red Table III's speaker sent a runner: the north ground feeds both villages or neither. They want to talk — properly, at their fire. Ignoring this is also an answer.

🌙 Raid — The Red Table III came in the night from the north. They trampled 2 garden plots into mud. Nobody's dead, but the message is clear: the ground is theirs too, and they're done asking. (Trust -10.)

🧳 Word of Haven’s the televised games, new bindings is doing work out there — Word comes late, through traders: Thornfield and The Red Table II have bound together — Thornfield primary. Other fires are climbing, too.
📓 Codex: Thornfield and The Red Table II bound; Thornfield primary.
You overhear it at the fire, and stop pretending not to listen. Riders from The Red Table II are telling the deer story again — with your name attached this time.

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and
🧳 Word comes late, through traders: The Red Table has bound itself to Thornfield. The region's map is being redrawn — not by Haven.

The warm hum behind your ribs is gone. The reactor went with Carmen's body — it does not come out, and it does not pass on. Hunger is back on the table. (One reactor per world, and the world already spent its one.)
You don't know what that was. An inflatable rat the size of a house. Someone at the haven should hear about this.
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
